description: Default E2B Firecracker microVM sandbox for Energy agent tasks. Minimal trust envelope.

trustEnvelope.notes: Strictest default. Callers can only narrow (not widen) without a trust-gate doc.

baseImage.notes: E2B's maintained base image. Check monthly for updates.

usagePattern: Short-lived task execution (< 5 min). Ideal for: eval runs, script execution, code generation + test cycles.

widening.networkEgressDomains: Add specific domains to allowedEgressDomains + document in a trust-gate-v{N}.md
widening.secretInjection: Add named slot to secretSlots; caller binds value at runtime via E2B SDK
